steps.description: Before going to the **Blue Castle**, we need to trigger the event in **Bistritz**.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: Make sure that **Keith** is in your party. Equip the **Mind's Eye** and anything else you want to boost his attack / hit area, since he'll be fighting a battle alone.

steps.description:
- Head over to the eastern side of town and head into **Nina**'s house.
- **Nina** will inform **Keith** of something she saw in the **Blue Castle**, which will now let you continue with the event there, so head over to the **Blue Castle**.

1. Head inside the castle, then go north up to the **Save Point**.
2. Take the western path, follow it around and down to the basement with the caskets.
3. Approach the open casket to find a **Golden Bat**!
4. It's actually **Keith**'s brother, and he'll give him the **Demon Swd-Tyrving**.
5. You'll then have to face him as **Keith** (alone) to earn it!

boss.name: Golden Bat
boss.strategy:
- He says you have 5 turns to defeat him before he obliterates **Keith**, but you technically have 6.
- It's not hard to succeed, but if you miss some hits, you could be in trouble.
- **Keith** can only attack normally, so just keep doing that.
- It should only take three turns max, unless you didn't equip the **Mind's Eye**, then it'll probably take all six.
- If you're having a hard time with this battle, then level **Keith** up to where he can definitely deal 1500 damage within four or five turns, to be safe.
- Note: even though you already have it equipped for this battle, the reward for winning is the **DemonSwd-Tyrving**......

steps.description: Another scene will follow afterward. When you regain control, head back upstairs and leave the **Blue Castle** entirely.
Switch **Keith** out of your party with someone else, then return to **Blue Castle**. If **Keith**'s in your party, then the next **Lottery Member** will not appear.

1. Make your way into the Castle and to the **Save Point**.
2. **Save**, then head down the eastern stairs and make your way to the throne room where you first met **Keith**.
3. There will be an invisible man here, much like **Keith**; talk to him, and he'll become the Vice Chairman (**Lottery Member No. 01**)!
4. The ring here is **insanely fast**, and there's no way to slow it down, so good luck!
5. Make sure to win the **Thief Earrings** before continuing on; it's like the Brigand and **Pirate Earrings** combined, with no downfall!
6. They'll allow you to get a 20% higher chance at treasure after battle, as well as 20% more Cash!
7. If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
8. Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!
